addr: Agamer Game Zone, South, E End Main Rd, near Bangalore Central Mall, Jayanagara 9th Block, J. P. Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560041, India

rev.t: Had been a regular in their older locations many many years back. Out of chance, I visited their current location today and it felt so good to see Anurag bro and aunty still providing the same warmth as they did when I was a little boy. …

I was initially confused between Xbox One S and PS3 Slim, but Mr. Anurag patiently explained everything based on my needs. He helped me understand the differences clearly and suggested the PS3 Slim as the better option for my use case. …
Really Good place. And the owners much better. A passionate gamer. Like playing ps games in his place. The best is, he has all games , you name it he has it. And he even sells them for a good price.
